# TypeScript Gotchas

> Known TypeScript patterns that bypass type safety or produce unexpected runtime behavior. Load all HIGH entries before writing any TypeScript.

## Entries

- [Type assertions with as](type-assertions.md): as bypasses the type checker entirely -- TypeScript trusts you unconditionally. Use type guards, satisfies, or instanceof instead for safe narrowing. HIGH.
- [Optional chaining vs nullish coalescing](nullish.md): ?. returns undefined on a missing property (does not throw). ?? only catches null and undefined -- it does NOT catch 0, empty string, or false. MEDIUM.
- [Pin Drizzle ORM to ^0.45.x](drizzle-version-pinning.md): v1.0.0-beta has breaking migration folder structure changes. Stay on 0.45.x until a deliberate upgrade window. HIGH.
- [Vitest jsdom requires separate install](vitest-jsdom.md): environment: "jsdom" in vitest.config.ts fails unless jsdom is installed as a devDependency. MEDIUM.
- [Vite $lib alias needs vite.config.ts](vite-lib-alias.md): Path alias in tsconfig.json only is not enough -- Vite/Rollup needs it in vite.config.ts resolve.alias too. MEDIUM.
- [Biome 2.x config format changed](biome-config-migration.md): organizeImports, files.ignore, and folder patterns all changed. Run npx biome migrate --write. MEDIUM.
- [Cascading import breakage on module deletion](cascading-import-breakage.md): Deleting modules causes chain-reaction build failures far beyond the listed files. Trace full import graph before deleting. HIGH.
- [SQL parameter index off-by-one in dynamic UPDATE builders](sql-parameter-index-off-by-one.md): Dynamic SET clause with appended fields shifts WHERE clause indices. Query executes without error but matches zero rows. Silent data loss. HIGH.
- [Date-only strings parse as UTC, off-by-one in local timezone](date-only-utc-off-by-one.md): new Date("2026-01-15") is UTC midnight; Intl.DateTimeFormat shows previous day in US timezones. MEDIUM.
- [Async singleton race condition](async-singleton-race.md): Guarding async singleton with null check on resolved value lets concurrent callers create duplicate instances. Store the promise, not the value. HIGH.
- [TypeScript 6 peer dep conflict with typescript-eslint](ts6-peer-dep-conflict.md): typescript-eslint 8.x requires typescript <6.0.0. Upgrading to TS 6 breaks npm ci in Docker/CI. Add legacy-peer-deps=true to .npmrc as a bridge. HIGH.
- [drizzle-kit migrate silently skips older when timestamps](drizzle-kit-migrate-silent-skip.md): drizzle-kit applies migrations by the when field in _journal.json, not file order. Newly generated migrations with when below the existing ceiling are skipped silently with a misleading success message. HIGH.
- [TS type predicate parameter-type assignability](type-predicate-assignability.md): User-defined predicates (x): x is T fail with TS2677 if T is not assignable to the parameter type. Common with Drizzle nullable left joins. MEDIUM.
- [drizzle-kit silent "no schema changes" when new schema file is missing from config](drizzle-kit-schema-not-in-config.md): drizzle-kit only inspects the explicit schema paths in drizzle.config.ts -- not the barrel re-exports. Forgetting to add a new schema file path silently produces an empty migration with the "No schema changes, nothing to migrate" message. HIGH.
- [Audit table FK to primary entity blocks pre-activation events](audit-table-fk-lifecycle.md): Audit tables that NOT NULL FK to a primary entity cannot record request -> approve -> activate lifecycle events. Decide upfront: parallel log channel, nullable FK, or split request + audit tables. MEDIUM.
- [Vitest mocks of Drizzle queries need a thenable .where()](vitest-drizzle-thenable-mock.md): Drizzle queries are thenables; if production code does `await db.select().from(t).where(cond)` without `.limit()`, mocks that only stub `.limit()` cause "rows is not iterable" far from the mock. Make `.where()` return both a `then`-able and a `.limit()`. HIGH.
- [pnpm overrides need an exact version to force re-resolution](pnpm-overrides-exact-version.md): Range-style overrides (e.g. ">=8.0.5") in pnpm.overrides act as peer-dep constraints, not forced re-resolution. Vulnerable transitives stay locked unless you pin to an exact version. HIGH.

- [`ALTER COLUMN ... SET NOT NULL` fails on existing NULL rows](drizzle-set-not-null-needs-backfill.md): drizzle-kit emits SET NOT NULL without a backfill UPDATE. Hand-edit the generated SQL to add `UPDATE x SET col = default WHERE col IS NULL` before the SET NOT NULL. HIGH.
- [vitest queue-shifting DB mocks break when guards add new DB calls](vitest-queue-shift-mocks-need-stubs-for-new-guard-hops.md): Adding a lifecycle/feature/audit check to a shared guard consumes a queue slot in unrelated route tests. Stub the new dep separately so it short-circuits. MEDIUM.
- [Migrating a function from sync to async silently breaks `if (!x)` guards](sync-to-async-truthy-check.md): After a function becomes Promise-returning, `const x = fn(); if (!x)` is always false because a Promise is truthy. tsc does not catch it; the not-found branch becomes dead code. Audit every caller. HIGH.
- [Broad tsconfig include type-checks scratch/template files anywhere in the repo](tsconfig-include-non-source.md): include: ["**/*.tsx"] with only node_modules excluded runs tsc and next build over reference .tsx files in tasks/, docs/, etc. A non-compiling template file there breaks the typecheck. Scope include or exclude non-source dirs. HIGH.
- [drizzle-kit generate aborts with a snapshot-chain collision on duplicate id/prevId](drizzle-kit-snapshot-collision.md): Copy-pasting a snapshot JSON without regenerating its id/prevId forks the linear chain; generate aborts with "pointing to a parent snapshot ... which is a collision". Re-link each snapshot to a unique id whose prevId equals the previous snapshot's id. HIGH.
- [Drizzle `sql` template renders a JS array into `= ANY(...)` as invalid SQL](drizzle-any-array-invalid-sql.md): `sql\`col = ANY(${jsArray})\`` expands to `ANY(($1, $2))`, which Postgres rejects -> query throws -> route 500s. Use `inArray(sql\`col\`, jsArray)` instead. HIGH.
- [req.params.id is string | string[] on nested routers](req-params-string-array.md): Express route params can widen to string | string[]; passing to a (id: string) helper fails tsc TS2345. Coerce with String(req.params.x). MEDIUM.
- [Number(null) silently coerces null/empty to 0](number-null-coercion.md): Number(null) and Number("") are 0, so a null SQL aggregate (avg over zero rows) becomes a real-looking 0. Guard null/undefined/"" before Number(). HIGH.
- [Compound tenant guards fail open on NULL](fail-open-compound-tenant-guard.md): Deny conditions written as `a && b && a !== b` silently grant access when either tenant id is NULL or req.user is missing. Write authorization as allow-if-X-else-deny. HIGH.
- [Auth middleware that degrades when its secret env var is unset](auth-middleware-env-secret-fallback.md): Token middleware that falls back to a staff-role check when the env var is missing (or on token mismatch) silently downgrades the boundary; fail closed and log. HIGH.
- [Sentinel values like 'all' or 'default' that skip authorization](sentinel-values-skip-authorization.md): Magic tenant-param values exempted from ownership checks become cross-tenant bypasses; give every sentinel its own authorization branch and never authorize from client-controlled headers. HIGH.
- [Splitting a switch over an untyped payload multiplies explicit `any`](split-dispatcher-multiplies-any.md): splitting a dispatcher (BullMQ job.data, webhook body) into exported per-handler functions turns one implicit any into an explicit data: any plus a lint suppression at every new signature; type the payloads as part of the split or file the typing follow-up with it. MEDIUM.
- [Adding Zod validation at a persisted-data load boundary can brick old data](zod-validation-at-persisted-data-boundary.md): Replacing `JSON.parse(...) as T` with a strict `schema.parse()` makes records written before newer fields existed unreadable in prod. Use a loose/passthrough schema at load boundaries and safeParse every existing record before shipping. HIGH.
- [Removing `as any` casts on discriminated unions: a cast that wont compile away is a real bug](discriminated-union-as-any-casts.md): Redundant casts on a typed union are mechanically removable, but the one site that fails tsc after removal is hiding a genuine mismatch -- fix the type or the code, never re-cast. MEDIUM.
- [Regex lookbehind is a parse-time SyntaxError on iOS Safari <16.4](regex-lookbehind-ios-safari.md): A regex literal with lookbehind `(?<=)` / `(?<!)` fails at PARSE time on iOS Safari before 16.4, so the whole module fails to load, not just the call site. Works on desktop so it ships undetected and breaks only on old iPhones; capture the prefix in a group instead. HIGH.
- [Default WHERE exclusion silently contradicts a user-supplied condition](default-where-nullifies-condition.md): A shared query builder that always appends an implicit default filter (hide closed/deleted/only-open) contradicts any user condition over the same column -> empty result, no error. Make the default opt-out-able (a skip flag) when a caller supplies explicit conditions. MEDIUM.
- [tsc runs out of heap compiling many zod-heavy files; transpile with esbuild](tsc-oom-zod-heavy-use-esbuild.md): tsc OOMs (unbounded heap growth, both TS 5.8 and 6.0) type-checking ~100+ files with large zod v3 schemas; raising --max-old-space-size does not help and it breaks Docker builds. Transpile+bundle with esbuild when you only need JS emit. MEDIUM.
- [Weak-type parameter rejects a wider interface (TS2559)](weak-type-param-rejects-wider-interface.md): A function with an all-optional parameter type (e.g. `{ officialPrecon?; gauntletDeck? }`) rejects an argument of a wider, unrelated-looking interface with TS2559 "no properties in common", even though the fields exist at runtime. Widen through an existing compatible interface (`const x: Wider = value`), not `as`. MEDIUM.
- [Storage helper default-bucket divergence silently drops email attachments](storage-helper-default-bucket-divergence.md): An optional bucket param with a default lets the writer (explicit media bucket) and reader (default builds bucket) drift -> deterministic NoSuchKey, and a best-effort catch-and-skip sent the customer email without its files while the UI showed them attached. Share one exported bucket constant across both paths and fail loud on attachment load failure. HIGH.
- [Zod `z.object()` strips undeclared keys, erasing them on a load-modify-write round-trip](zod-object-strips-undeclared-keys.md): A field that is persisted but not declared on the schema is silently deleted the first time any code path does parse -> mutate -> write. No error, no warning, no type error (the writer uses a loose shell, so tsc never checks it). Surfaces much later as behavior drift. Declare every persisted field as `.optional()`, and test the round-trip with a control asserting unknown keys are still stripped. HIGH.
- [A lint rule can directly contradict a tsconfig compiler flag](lint-rule-contradicts-compiler-flag.md): `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true` types every `arr[i]` as `T | undefined`, making `!` the sanctioned escape hatch, while the linter's noNonNullAssertion forbids `!` -- 81% of 743 findings were literally `arr[i]!` or `map.get(k)!`. Sample the finding SHAPES before treating a large lint backlog as debt; the fix here is disabling the rule with recorded rationale, at zero code churn. HIGH.
- [A green typecheck + test run can prove nothing about an entire directory](tsconfig-exclude-voids-green-gates.md): A directory excluded from every tsconfig and holding no test files passes both gates for free -- two ReferenceErrors survived a full 2041-test green run in `src/public`. Check which program each file is in, and cover excluded JS trees with `biome check --only=correctness/noUndeclaredVariables`, validated with a deliberate failing probe first. HIGH.

- [Denormalized identity fields go stale on mutation; a precedence accessor and a "healing" read API hide it](denormalized-id-stale-on-mutation.md): An entity id stored in an authoritative field AND a nested copy, read via `a ?? b`, goes stale when a mutation updates only the nested copy -- the top-level winner still resolves the OLD entity. A list API that reports the nested field, an image-only audit, and a nulls-only backfill all give false "fixed" signals. Re-sync every copy in the same write; verify through the exact accessor. HIGH.

- [tsc OOM on zod-heavy files is usually TWO COPIES of zod, not heap size](tsc-oom-duplicate-zod-copies.md): tsc exhausts the heap and TS2589 points at your OWN generic, but the real cause is two zod copies in one program (package pins v3 while the hoisted @modelcontextprotocol/sdk resolves zod/v3 + zod/v4/core to a root v4), forcing an unbounded structural comparison through the SDK's v3/v4 conditional type. Raising --max-old-space-size never helps because the instantiation is unbounded, not large. Diagnose by counting copies (`find . -path '*/node_modules/zod/package.json'`) and confirming with --traceResolution; dedupe to one version -- a 290-file package went from OOM at 16 GB to exit 0 in 1.7 s. Do NOT settle for the esbuild-only workaround, which silently stops type-checking the package forever. HIGH.

- [A source-scanning lint must assert its own coverage, or "no findings" means nothing](lint-must-assert-its-own-coverage.md): A custom lint that finds violations by scanning source text passes identically whether it saw everything or almost nothing. A line-oriented regex matched 73 of 242 `loopback(` call sites -- the formatter wraps most calls across lines -- so the rule reported green while ignoring 70% of the codebase. Parse structurally (balance parens, skip strings/templates) AND cross-check the parsed count against a dumb textual count of the same token, with a lower-bound tripwire so both collapsing to 0 still fails. Prove the lint red by reintroducing the bug before trusting it. HIGH.
